rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "Read for the decisions that matter": line 39 header verb is "Read"; line 43: "Scan for the decisions most likely to change the work: files, design, assumptions, and verification." — the chunk's own body instructs scanning, contradicting the header's verb. This is the identical read-vs-scan defect the maintainer block (line 158) records fixing at the sibling chunk-4 header ("Header was Read the plan... until 2026-08-12; Antti caught read-vs-scan") — that fix landed on chunk 4 ("## Scan the plan before you push back") but chunk 3's header still reads "Read." Harm: this training's own spine argues against exhaustive reading (M1's countermove, restated one bullet below in the same chunk), so a header instructing "Read" directly above content instructing "Scan" undercuts the point it is trying to teach — not a cosmetic mismatch.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Retitle chunk 3's header to use "Scan" (or another verb matching the body's own instruction), mirroring the fix already applied to chunk 4.
